notes: Read the full 194-line numbered source before editing; every line was considered. Imports (web L1-9): useMemo (react); useTranslation('dashboard') (react-i18next); lucide-react Map; CircleMarker (@/components/maps); Badge (@/components/ui); useVehiclePositions/useVehicles (@/api/hooks/useVehicles); WidgetShell (./WidgetShell); WidgetMapView (./shared); WidgetProps (./types). All ported or reduced to native-safe equivalents (see deps note).

Ported verbatim (pure, no DOM): ClusterPoint interface (web L11-17); clusterPositions (web L23-57) — skip (0,0), `${(lat*precision)|0}:${(lon*precision)|0}` bucket key, running-mean lat/lon + count, max-count scan, intensity=count/maxCount; centroid (web L59-68) — avg lat/lon, empty -> [37.7749,-122.4194] SF fallback; intensityColor (web L70-77) — r=20+i*225, g=184-i*120, b=166+i*60, alpha=0.35+i*0.55 rgba string. Byte-for-byte logic + comments preserved.

Component derivations (web L79-118) preserved 1:1: useTranslation('dashboard')->useNativeTranslation; vehicles=useVehicles(); id=vehicleId ?? vehicles?.[0]?.id ?? 0; useVehiclePositions(id) destructure (data/isLoading/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch); safePositions=positions??[] (wrapped in useMemo([positions]) to satisfy native error-level react-hooks/exhaustive-deps — identical contents); isCompact=size.cols<=1; isWide=size.cols>=3; precision=isCompact?200:500; clusters=useMemo(clusterPositions(safePositions,precision),[safePositions,precision]); center=useMemo(centroid(clusters),[clusters]); totalPositions=safePositions.length; isEmpty=clusters.length===0; shellProps={loading,updatedAt:dataUpdatedAt,isFetching,isStale,isError,onRefresh:()=>refetch()}.

Compact branch (web L120-153): <WidgetShell {...shellProps} noPadding> wrapping <WidgetMapView center zoom=11 compact isEmpty emptyMessage 'No position data'> + clusters.map -> <CircleMarker key=i center=[lat,lon] radius=4+i*6 pathOptions={color:'transparent', fillColor:intensityColor, fillOpacity:0.4+i*0.5}>. The web's redundant post-spread updatedAt/isFetching/isStale/isError/onRefresh duplicates (web L124-128) carry the same values as {...shellProps}, so they are folded into the single spread (behaviour-identical; avoids react/jsx-no-duplicate-props). The marker-cluster:no rationale JSX comment (web L137) is retained.

Standard/Wide branch (web L155-193): titled <WidgetShell title 'Position Heatmap' icon=Map glyph noPadding actions={isWide && totalPositions>0 ? <Badge>{{count}} positions</Badge> : undefined} {...shellProps}> wrapping <WidgetMapView center zoom={isWide?12:11} isEmpty emptyMessage> + clusters.map -> <CircleMarker radius=6+i*(isWide?14:10) fillOpacity=0.35+i*0.55>. Same marker-cluster:no JSX comment (web L178). export default function (web L79/194) retained; the trailing blank line (web L195) is a no-op.

i18n keys + English defaults preserved (widget.positionHeatmap.noData 'No position data', .title 'Position Heatmap', .count '{{count}} positions'). useNativeTranslation implements i18next-style {{name}} interpolation on the default value so t('widget.positionHeatmap.count','{{count}} positions',{count:totalPositions}) yields 'N positions' exactly (web L164-166).

Browser-only / unported deps reduced and documented inline + here: react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation t(key,fallback?,params?)=interpolate(fallback ?? key); lucide-react Map -> 🗺 glyph tinted colors.accent (text-neon-cyan); @/components/maps CircleMarker + ./shared WidgetMapView's MapContainer/MapTileLayer (react-leaflet + 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css' — DOM/CSS-only, and apps/native ships NO map library) -> native WidgetMapView density canvas: fixed #1a1a2e backdrop (the web inline map background) projecting every marker through the SAME Web Mercator / EPSG:3857 math Leaflet uses (projectMercator centred on `center` at `zoom`) into an absolutely-positioned circular View (left/top=x-r/y-r, size 2r, borderRadius r, backgroundColor=fillColor, opacity=fillOpacity so effective alpha = rgba alpha × fillOpacity, matching SVG fill+fill-opacity); color:'transparent' stroke -> no border; @/components/ui Badge neutral sm -> surfaceRaised/border/textSecondary rounded-full chip; @/api/hooks useVehicles/useVehiclePositions -> already-ported native web-parity hooks (request auto-prefixes /api/v1 so '/vehicles' and '/vehicles/{id}/positions' stay verbatim; Position{latitude,longitude}); ./WidgetShell -> native shell reproducing loading skeleton, error body, 1500ms pulse-on-update glow, inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph+relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less), plus the noPadding + actions slots; @/components/feedback EmptyState (via WidgetMapView) -> centered muted message (py-4); ./types WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize{cols,rows}+WidgetProps.

Genuinely-unavailable native pieces (explicit): the raster tile basemap imagery and pan/zoom/scroll-wheel/drag interaction Leaflet provides have no apps/native analogue (no map library) and are reduced to the static dark canvas + auto-fit Mercator projection. The web compact map already disables scrollWheelZoom/zoomControl/dragging, so the static native canvas matches compact intent; for standard/wide it is a non-interactive density still. No DOM/Leaflet/recharts imports in native output.

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet, npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles. Output path: apps/native/src/web-parity/features/dashboard/widgets/PositionHeatmapWidget.tsx. This is a standalone web-parity port (not wired into the src/widgets registry), verified by typecheck + lint like its sibling widget ports.
